settings.heading: Speaking and Appearances.
settings.subheading: Angela Serravalle speaks on trauma, psychology, clinical practice, and the art of clinical writing. Available for academic conferences, clinical trainings, and literary events.

settings.heading: What speaking looks like.
settings.body: Dr. Serravalle's speaking engagements fall into two categories: clinical training (CE-approved presentations for professional audiences, typically through the CFBL Institute) and public lectures (university settings, literary conferences, and cultural organizations interested in psychology, memory, and clinical narrative). She speaks from a clinical and writerly perspective. Never from a motivational one.

settings.heading: Speaking inquiries.
settings.subheading: Please include your organization, event type, audience, and proposed dates. Responses within 5 business days.
